ck: (27)kasitinanacarya astu tarhyapatya eva srutyukto peta ityata aha — yati punariti avivata iti apatyatvasyEva paranartikatvarupatayasnatapinatasiteriti pava petasrutervyavaharikapetaparatve patakanapitaya satakapavanaha — kutasceti atvEtasya vyavaharikatvasanpavat pratipasiketyuktan nanvevanatvEtasrutinanaprananyaprasanka iti cet tvanate tvEtasrutinanaprananyaprasankena tulyatvatiti pava syatevan yatyapatyartapratipatakatvan prananyan syat na cEvan api tvapatyartaparatvan tva suparnetyatinan ca petanuvatakanan tanisetaparatvateva prananyopapati ata eva tatpratipatyapetasya patyatvanapityasayena sankate — nanviti artavatapakasyeti tasya pratipatyartapataniyanapavepya patyavityartakaryaparatvenEva prananyankikaratiti pava natantare pratipatyartepi prananyat ninansakanata ityuktan evan satyatvEtasrutinan pratipasikatvEtaparatvepi naprananyaprasanka ityasayenaha — neheti vakyanyanuvatantityanvaya petavatapetasya pratyaksena praptyapavataha — vinata iti nanu tvasuparnetyatinan katanapetanisetaparatvan ? tatartakapatapavatata aha — petasyeti tatatnyanisetarupatvat apetapavarupatvat tataca petartasyEva tatartakatvanoktatosa iti pava evan petasruterapetanisetakatvasanartanena vacaspatyuktanapi pratyuktanityaha — eteneti prapalaniti tataca tena petasrutereva pata anyata netan racataniti pratyaksasyapi prapalyasiteritan racataniti pratyaksapatakatvanupapatiriti pava pratyuktaniti petasruterapi nisetakatvasanye turpalatvayokatiti pava ata petasyapetanisetarupatvepyapetanisetatvena petapratipatakatvat tva suparnetyaterturpalatvaneveti cetatra vaktavyan kinapetacnanan prati apetanisetatvenEva petacnanan virotyuta petatvenapi atyenupavavireta kata patapina ityaticnanatasayan catvapi tatapetacnananutayat tvitiye tu katan tva suparnetyaterturpalatvan ? virotitvavisesat na cEvanuktatiprasanka niscitaprananyakatvena prapalyat pariksaya ca taniscayat nisetakatvanatrasyaprayocakatvat anyata `na hinsyatityate`raknisoniyanityatisrutipatakatvaprasankat na cEvan petapetavakyayo prapalyatOrpalyanirnaya niravakasatvatina tanirnayat niravakasatvan ca petavakyananevetyanyatra prapancitan nanvapetasrutinan nanuvatakatvasanpava apetasya pratyaksenapraptatvat na ca praptinatrananuvataprayocakan sarvasyapyanunanata praptisanpavena srutinatrasyapyanuvatakatvaprasankatityata aha — na hiti iti vakyananuvatakan na syatityanvaya istapatinirasartananuvatakatvena sarvasanataniti pratyaksapraptapratipatakatve tosapavatanvayavyatirekarupanunanapraptan karanatvanartan pratipatayatiti karanatvasya
s: (२७)काशीतिम्मण्णाचार्य अस्तु तर्ह्यबाध्य एव श्रुत्युक्तो भेद इत्यत आह — यदि पुनरिति अविवाद इति अबाध्यत्वस्यैव पारमार्थिकत्वरूपतयाऽस्मदभिमतसि
